# Discovery — task-artifacts

Re-classified T2 → T3 (2026-10-30): an artifact's content is free text its authors wrote, and it can
name an absolute path; RULES holds "no path reaches `web/` but Find projects' answer", and
feature-task-details already drops an action's `reason` for that one rule. Showing documents as they
are written touches the invariant, which is T3.

## Facts checked (Jig 0.39.0, in this project since #84)

- `jig task artifacts <id> --json` → `{task, artifacts: [{kind, state, reason, updated_at, bytes}]}`,
  one entry per kind Jig writes, in Jig's order: task, discovery, spec, alternatives, design, plan,
  review, verification, handoff, knowledge-map, commit-message, pr-body. `state` is `present`,
  `empty`, `missing` or `unavailable`; `reason` only for `unavailable`, from a fixed set of words
  (symlink loop, unreadable link, missing parent, outside workspace, missing or not a regular file,
  unreadable) — never a path. Unknown task: `error.code` `not-found`, exit 1.
- `jig task artifact read <id> <kind> --json` → `{task, kind, updated_at, bytes, content}`, the file's
  bytes as they are. Missing: `not-found`; unavailable: `failed`. Nothing is written.
- Both find the workspace where it really is, a worktree's included (`_task_workspace_root`):
  Jig UI needs no path of its own, as adr-20261014-jig-ui-is-an-optional-layer-over-jig requires.
- Jig before 0.39.0 has neither (`task artifacts` prints text only; `task artifact` only writes).
  jig#347 is closed.
- Of the 17 documents in this project's live workspaces today, none names an absolute path; nothing
  stops an agent writing one (a scratch folder, a log line).
- The page has no Markdown renderer; the package's dependencies are hono, @hono/node-server and zod.
- TaskView re-reads on a change of its project (`onChange`); task details are served from the board's
  read and cost no extra Jig run (feature-task-details). Documents would be two Jig runs of their
  own, on demand.
